sentences.text: The genus is defined by a partial snout and lower jaw elements, including a second snout assigned to the group.
Its snout featured serrated, interlocking teeth that formed a zig-zag cutting edge.
The genus Pabwehshi was named in 2001 by Jeffrey A. Wilson and his colleagues.
Fossils were uncovered in the Vitakri and Pab formations located in Balochistan, Pakistan.
Pabwehshi is classified as an extinct genus of baurusuchine mesoeucrocodylian.
Larsson and Sues (2007) suggested a close affinity between Pabwehshi and the family Peirosauridae within Sebecia.
The type species is P. pakistanensis, a name referencing the country where the fossils were found.
This animal lived during the Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period.
Scientists estimate its time range falls between 72.2 and 66 million years ago.
